title: Austin Settles Property Lines, Waives Claims
summary:
*   **Austin Street & Alley Boundaries Set:** Official lines for East Eighth Street, Brazos Street, and an alley in Block 97 were formally established.
*   **City Waives Encroachment Claims:** The city agreed to waive any claims for "real or supposed encroachment" from properties bordering these newly defined lines, providing clarity and security for adjacent landowners.
*   **Swift Policy Approval:** The ordinance was rapidly passed in one meeting, with the usual three-day reading rule suspended to expedite its final adoption.
